subject: PO exception routing and temporary spend cap release for TalonTech onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: TalonTech Procurement <procurement@talontech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO exception routing and temporary spend cap release for TalonTech onboarding

Hi Jordan / TalonTech procurement team,

Thanks for the fast intro last week. We finished vendor onboarding on our side and are ready to request a PO number and a temporary spend cap release to cover initial ramp activity. Quick summary:

- Account: TalonTech (primary contact: Jordan Park)
- Initial onboarding month estimate: $95,000 (compute + support + integration work)
- Requested temporary spend cap: $120,000 for 30 days to avoid throttling during the first wave of tests
- Line items attached: initial_line_items.csv (compute SKUs, support hours, integration fixed fee)

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (completed), initial_line_items.csv.

Could you route a provisional PO (or PO exception) to finance that provisions the temporary cap? We can accept a provisional PO number that will be replaced with a final PO after SOW sign-off, but we need the number and confirmation of the cap value before we start live traffic.

If you need any additional fields on the onboarding form (tax ID, remittance address), let me know — I can send an updated version in an hour.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts (Americas)
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

---

From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@talontech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@talontech.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: PO exception routing and temporary spend cap release for TalonTech onboarding

Vanessa, thanks — we can do a provisional PO number but procurement needs two items before issuance:

1) TalonTech requires supplier tax ID and W9 (or equivalent) on file.
2) We need a mapping from your SKUs to our internal cost centers. The compute line items currently have generic SKUs; our finance team wants them split into: Compute - Dev, Compute - Prod, Integration Services.

I attached TalonTech's PO template for your reference. Also, our legal asked whether Redwood will accept a 30-day provisional payment term for the pilot.

I can route the provisional PO to finance once we have the W9 and the SKU-to-cost-center mapping. If you can confirm the temporary cap ($120k) in writing and provide the W9, I will flag this as time-sensitive and request expedited processing.

—Jordan
Jordan Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, TalonTech
procurement@talontech.com

Attachments: talon_po_template.pdf

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@talontech.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO exception routing and temporary spend cap release for TalonTech onboarding

Jordan — copying finance and procurement ops folks for visibility.

We can provide the W9 and a cost-center split. A couple of notes to accelerate:

- We propose issuing a provisional PO for 90 days capped at $120,000 with monthly reconciliation and a required final PO after SOW execution. That removes the need to reissue a PO mid-flow and gives both sides visibility.
- Attached is our provisional_po_template.pdf that finance is comfortable with; you can use that as the source for the provisional PO.
- SKU mapping (high level):
  * RED-COMP-STD -> Compute - Prod
  * RED-COMP-DYN -> Compute - Dev
  * RED-INT-SVC -> Integration Services

Vanessa and I will upload the W9 to your secure folder by end of day. If procurement is okay with a provisional 90-day instrument instead of a 30-day provisional, that gives us breathing room; otherwise we can accept 30 days.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Business Partner, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: provisional_po_template.pdf

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@talontech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO exception routing and temporary spend cap release for TalonTech onboarding

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply. We agree to the provisional 90-day PO approach; it helps our engineering schedule. Action items below:

- I attached an updated onboarding form (redwood_updated_onboarding_form_v2.pdf) that includes our W9, remittance address, and tax ID.
- Also attached: updated line items CSV with SKU -> cost center mapping (we corrected RED-COMP-STD to Prod and split support/engineering hours into Integration Services).
- Request: please issue a provisional PO number and assign temporary spend cap = $120,000. Note in the PO that this is provisional and will be replaced by the final PO post-SOW signature.
- Please send the PO number back to me and the DocuSign link when ready so we can attach the PO to our procurement record.

If there are any template fields TalonTech needs filled differently, tell us and we will update immediately. We appreciate the expedited handling.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts (Americas)
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_updated_onboarding_form_v2.pdf, updated_line_items_with_costcenter.csv
